title: Eggs with aubergine and yoghurt
summary: Eggs with aubergine and yoghurt is a middle eastern dinner built around medium eggs and aubergines, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Pat medium eggs dry and season it. Prep aubergines and 0% fat Greek style yoghurt for Eggs with aubergine and yoghurt so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook medium eggs on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook aubergines and 0% fat Greek style yoghurt in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Eggs with aubergine and yoghurt before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice medium eggs and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
